alex: CI red on //runtime/serve:retry_flow_test — failing ~30% in CI runs. build: https://ci.redwood.example/1749999999 :confused: Anyone able to bisect or run a noisy repro?
joanna: @alex can you paste the failing assert/log and last green commit?
alex: pasted logs below:
```
--- FAIL: TestRetryFlow (0.03s)
retry_flow_test.go:128: expected 3 retries, got 2
  --- FAIL: TestRetryFlow (0.02s)
  panic: send on closed channel
  goroutine 42 [running]:
    runtime.throw(0x...)
    .../retry_flow_test.go:128 +0x...
```
alex: repro locally is flaky — only fails on my machine when GOMAXPROCS=1 (weird).
miguel: :eyes: that smells like timer jitter + lock ordering. we saw similar with the session heartbeat tests. try setting TEST_SEED and disabling jitter to see if it stabilizes: `TEST_SEED=98765 TEST_DISABLE_JITTER=1`
ryan: I'll start a bisect run. what was the last green?
alex: CI shows green at 1749975000, commit b3e7a1f. bad commit range looks small — recent lock/cond change landed in de3f...
joanna: also try `--runs_per_test=50` or `--test_arg=--race` if helpful. more runs help reproduce flakes.
ryan: kicking off rerun now: `TEST_SEED=98765 TEST_DISABLE_JITTER=1 bazel test //runtime/serve:retry_flow_test --test_output=errors --runs_per_test=50` — will update with results.
ci-bot: Build queued: https://ci.redwood.example/1750000010 — queued on linux-amd64.
alex: if disabling jitter hides it, that suggests timing-sensitive ordering. might need to tighten the teardown ordering or make retry backoff deterministic in tests.
miguel: quick thought — if it's only on GOMAXPROCS=1, maybe goroutine scheduling exposes a race around `retryPending` flag. worth adding a defensive check in the test while we bisect.
ryan: bisect progress 1/40: first candidate b4a12... failed with same trace. continuing.
alex: great — thanks for the quick run. if bisect points to de3f... we can try a revert patch or add a test-only guard.
joanna: if this blocks merges, we should skip the flaky on the CI lane that runs single-core until fix. add a flakey tag and open a PR to skip.
ryan: update: runs with TEST_DISABLE_JITTER=1 are passing so far, without it ~15% fail. posting full bisect log once done.
alex: perfect. once you have the guilty commit, ping me and I'll prepare a minimal repro/test and a fix PR.
ryan: will do. ping @oncall if this ends up blocking release branches.
ci-bot: Build started on linux-amd64 (1750000055).
alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
